acceptance: The candidate auxiliary and documentation jobs use fetch-depth: 1 (or default depth).
Tests that pin checkout properties in those workflows are updated and pass.
Each converted job passes in CI with no failures or skipped checks caused by missing history.
Workflows requiring ancestry or commit ranges (soundness-merge-digest, site-inputs, validate-submission) remain at full depth.
context: Part of the shallow-clone CI optimization plan. Audit confirms these jobs need only the HEAD tree or compare against an explicitly fetched shallow ref. comment-policy-nightly runs --full which sets base=HEAD. example-validation runs make docs-validate which uses ls-files only.
description: Convert checkouts in standalone, audit, and documentation jobs that need only the checked-out tree from fetch-depth: 0 to depth 1. Candidate jobs include corpus-drift-check, submission-validator-drift-check, nightly-v2 (drift job), comment-policy-nightly, and ci.yml example-validation. Update tests that pin checkout properties (such as test_trunk_workflow.py for comment-policy-scan if converted). Do not change jobs that compute commit diffs or ancestry (such as soundness-merge-digest, site-inputs, or validate-submission).
